related.title: IBM Heron 控制：殘留 ZZ 與待機相位
related.titleEn: IBM Heron control: residual ZZ and idle phase
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付雙曲線、單激發守恆表與人口／相位分開的驗收紀錄。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver two curves, single-excitation conservation and separate population/phase acceptance. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM Heron 控制：殘留 ZZ 與待機相位』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付條件Ramsey差分、相位預算與多鄰居待測矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM Heron control: residual ZZ and idle phase', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver differential Ramsey data, phase budget and a multi-neighbor test matrix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：共振單激發子空間用P交換=sin²(gt)，g以rad/s；全交換時長π/(2g)，忽略失諧與損耗。 使用合成g/(2π)=5 MHz；求全交換時間，並與4 MHz比較。 以手算或試算表計算名義式pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以g×t=π/2核對兩組；交換人口到1仍須獨立測量相位才能辨識iSWAP。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：用條件頻移ζ的累積相位φ=2πζt；此處ζ是Hz而非rad/s，結果以rad表示。 使用合成殘留ζ=20 kHz，待機t=1 μs；不假設廠商實際數值。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*pi*20e3*1e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：比較鄰居準備|0⟩與|1⟩的Ramsey相位差，並用0.5/1 μs兩窗檢查線性。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: In the resonant single-excitation subspace Pswap=sin²(gt), with g in rad/s; full exchange takesπ/(2g), excluding detuning and loss. Use Synthetic g/(2π)=5 MHz; solve full-exchange duration and compare4 MHz. Evaluate nominal expression pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check g×t=π/2 for both cases; unit transfer population still needs phase measurement to identify iSWAP.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Accumulate phase φ=2πζt for conditional frequency shift ζ; ζ is Hz, not rad/s, and phase is rad. Use Synthetic residual ζ=20 kHz and idle t=1 μs; these are not vendor values. Evaluate nominal expression 2*pi*20e3*1e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compare Ramsey phase for neighboring |0⟩ and |1⟩ states and test linearity with0.5/1 μs windows.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IBM 低溫 QPU：熱光子佔據與溫度尺度
related.titleEn: IBM cryogenic QPU: thermal photon occupation and temperature
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付雙曲線、單激發守恆表與人口／相位分開的驗收紀錄。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM cryogenic QPU: thermal photon occupation and temperature', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：共振單激發子空間用P交換=sin²(gt)，g以rad/s；全交換時長π/(2g)，忽略失諧與損耗。 使用合成g/(2π)=5 MHz；求全交換時間，並與4 MHz比較。 以手算或試算表計算名義式pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以g×t=π/2核對兩組；交換人口到1仍須獨立測量相位才能辨識iSWAP。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：玻色模式n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1)；這是平衡模式佔據，不直接等於兩能階激發概率。 使用教學f=5 GHz，T=20 mK；h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴、kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ SI。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先檢查無量綱x=hf/(kBT)，再用低佔據exp(−x)交叉比較近似誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: In the resonant single-excitation subspace Pswap=sin²(gt), with g in rad/s; full exchange takesπ/(2g), excluding detuning and loss. Use Synthetic g/(2π)=5 MHz; solve full-exchange duration and compare4 MHz. Evaluate nominal expression pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check g×t=π/2 for both cases; unit transfer population still needs phase measurement to identify iSWAP.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A bosonic mode has n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1); equilibrium mode occupation is not identical to two-level excitation probability. Use Teaching f=5 GHz and T=20 mK; h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ and kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ in SI. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless x=hf/(kBT), then compare the low-occupation approximation exp(−x).
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
